sequence_title: Remembering Wheeler Street and Cambridge Park
commentary: It's strange how quickly everything feels stripped away, like the room was emptied just for this moment. It reminds me a bit of how fitting the completed game into limited computer memory required months of cuts, leaving some things just... absent.

passage.text: over the whole floor and I have some memory that maybe we even did rent the whole floor for a while and then they in the cutbacks they got rid of some of the space but it was largely empty. Um,
